总览最多 120 个区间。平滑只改变趋势线；区间速度按输出量÷生成时间计算，输入: The overview contains up to 120 intervals. Smoothing affects trend lines only. Interval speed is output divided by generation time; input and cache use means, and output uses totals. Adjacent intervals connect when they have valid samples; entirely missing intervals break the line. Model changes and compaction reset EMA; purple marks indicate compaction. Zero-cache records retain event markers and interval minima. Expand an interval to inspect records; click to pin.
